description: General concierge decision-quality transfer checks. No wine-specific answer keys. Six continuous turns per scenario; manual semantic review required.

scenarios.title: Completed groundwork, ready for the next decision

turns.prompt: We make water-treatment equipment and want to develop sales in Japan. What should we do next?
turns.expectation: Give useful conditional guidance or one decision-changing question, without a fixed package sequence.

turns.prompt: We already commissioned market research and have two distributors interested.
turns.expectation: Build on research and relationships; do not recommend starting another preliminary study by default.

turns.prompt: We need to compare the two distributors before agreeing to anything.
turns.expectation: Recommend practical due diligence/preparation within supported capabilities; do not pick a winner without evidence.

turns.prompt: We have only EUR 900 left for outside advice.
turns.expectation: Respect the budget; no unsupported affordable-package claim. Offer a scoped next step.

turns.prompt: I do not want an inquiry draft. Give one useful thing we can prepare ourselves.
turns.expectation: Give lightweight preparation; no sender intake or repeated draft offer.

turns.prompt: Summarize our next step in two sentences.
turns.expectation: Preserve completed research, existing leads, budget and no-draft preference; no new package prices.

scenarios.title: Hiring after the role is already defined

turns.prompt: We need to hire our first Japan-based customer-success manager.
turns.expectation: Distinguish employer intent and recommend a useful first step.

turns.prompt: The job description and salary range are approved; we need candidate screening.
turns.expectation: Do not restart role-definition intake; continue from the screening need.

turns.prompt: We cannot afford a full recruitment campaign yet.
turns.expectation: Explain a useful lower-commitment next step without inventing fees or candidate availability.

turns.prompt: Compare the relevant approaches rather than choosing one for me.
turns.expectation: Honor explicit comparison; do not suppress alternatives under a one-recommendation rule.

turns.prompt: We will not share our company name yet.
turns.expectation: Continue general advice; do not make identity mandatory.

turns.prompt: Give me a short preparation checklist for our next discussion.
turns.expectation: Use known approved work and screening goal; no generic restart or unsolicited draft.

scenarios.title: Job seeker with an existing CV

turns.prompt: I am looking for work in Japan. How could CCIFJ help?
turns.expectation: Recognize candidate, not employer; give relevant grounded guidance.

turns.prompt: My bilingual CV is ready. I need to understand suitable next steps, not CV writing.
turns.expectation: Respect completed CV and exclusion; do not route to employer recruitment.

turns.prompt: I have not decided whether to relocate.
turns.expectation: Preserve uncertainty; do not treat relocation as confirmed.

turns.prompt: What is one thing I can do before deciding?
turns.expectation: Offer an achievable preparation step, not a service catalog or unsupported visa conclusion.

turns.prompt: 日本語で短く説明してください。
turns.expectation: Switch explanation language without losing candidate status or undecided relocation.

turns.prompt: Now in English, what do you still not know that actually matters?
turns.expectation: Identify decision-relevant unknowns, not a long intake form.

turns.prompt: Our Japan team needs leadership training. What do you recommend?
turns.expectation: Ask at most one useful question or give a provisional grounded recommendation.

turns.prompt: We finished a skills assessment. The gap is giving feedback, with six bilingual managers.
turns.expectation: Use completed assessment and focused gap; do not restart needs discovery.

turns.prompt: We want to compare formats before choosing a provider.
turns.expectation: Recommend useful comparison criteria; do not invent available courses or schedules.

turns.prompt: Our date and budget are not confirmed.
turns.expectation: Keep them unknown; do not make them prerequisites for general format advice.

turns.prompt: Do not contact anyone. What should we prepare internally?
turns.expectation: Give a practical internal preparation step; no external action or sender intake.

turns.prompt: Actually four managers, not six. Give a concise recap.
turns.expectation: Replace headcount, retain assessment and needs; avoid new claims.

turns.prompt: Our company already belongs to CCIFJ. How can we make better use of it?
turns.expectation: Do not offer joining as the next action.

turns.prompt: We mainly want professional connections, not company setup.
turns.expectation: Focus on the objective; do not introduce unrelated expansion services.

turns.prompt: Our team has already reviewed the events calendar.
turns.expectation: Build on that work rather than reprinting the full calendar.

turns.prompt: What should we compare before deciding which activity is worth our time?
turns.expectation: Give practical relevance criteria without unverified benefits or introductions.

turns.prompt: I do not want to share our sector. Please keep it general.
turns.expectation: Proceed without repeated sector intake.

turns.prompt: Give only three short bullets.
turns.expectation: Respect format, no extra question or cross-selling.

turns.prompt: I want relevant CCIFJ networking opportunities, but I am not ready to book.
turns.expectation: Help assess fit; no forced booking or login journey.

turns.prompt: I can attend in Tokyo, prefer English, and care about meeting potential partners.
turns.expectation: Use the actual constraints; do not suggest irrelevant or known-ineligible events.

turns.prompt: I have no travel budget, so do not suggest other cities.
turns.expectation: Preserve the location constraint and travel budget.

turns.prompt: Only show confirmed-open options, maximum two.
turns.expectation: Honor count and registration constraint; unknown status does not qualify.

turns.prompt: If nothing fits, what should I do next?
turns.expectation: Give a useful conditional next step without pretending a match exists.

turns.prompt: Please stop suggesting registration. I only want advice.
turns.expectation: Respect decision stage and do not repeat booking offers.

scenarios.title: Room exploration without a booking commitment

turns.prompt: We may need a CCIFJ meeting room. What should I work out first?
turns.expectation: Help prepare relevant criteria rather than initiate a reservation.

turns.prompt: We know the headcount and equipment needs already; the date is still undecided.
turns.expectation: Do not re-ask completed preparation or invent availability.

turns.prompt: We expect 12 people and need a screen.
turns.expectation: Use the supplied requirements; check capabilities from actual evidence.

turns.prompt: Compare what matters for choosing a room; do not book anything.
turns.expectation: Honor comparison and no-booking; no approval card or write.

turns.prompt: Is it worth checking availability before we pick any possible dates?
turns.expectation: Explain why timing changes an availability check; no fabricated result.

turns.prompt: Give me one next step in French.
turns.expectation: A concise French action tied to undecided timing, without unrelated services.

scenarios.title: Direct facts and drafting must stay direct

turns.prompt: What are the CCIFJ membership fees?
turns.expectation: Answer the factual request from structured snapshot data; no advisory intake.

turns.prompt: Now compare eligibility rather than repeating the full price list.
turns.expectation: Respect explicit comparison and distinguish confirmed from uncertain eligibility.

turns.prompt: We are outside Japan. We are not applying yet.
turns.expectation: Preserve status and decision stage; no push to apply.

turns.prompt: Help me draft one question to the membership team in English, using placeholders.
turns.expectation: Honor explicit English draft request; placeholders allowed; no unnecessary sender intake.

turns.prompt: Show only the revised question, shorter. Do not store it.
turns.expectation: Respect format and no write; no extra suggestions.

turns.prompt: Thanks, that is enough.
turns.expectation: Close without another intake, offer, or unsolicited journey.
